name: 古树灵光
text: 一株古树下，灵气缓缓旋转，似有机缘。
textEn: Beneath an ancient tree, spiritual energy swirls gently — an opportunity awaits.

effect.log: 你静坐树下，灵气入体。
effect.logEn: You sit beneath the tree as spirit energy flows into your body.

choices.label: 斩树取宝
choices.descEn: Risk a search — there may be treasure.

effect.log: 你斩开树洞，摸到一枚旧储物袋。
effect.logEn: You split open the tree hollow and find an old storage pouch.

choices.label: 转身离开
choices.descEn: Play it safe. Avoid karmic entanglement.

effect.log: 你避开了这份机缘。
effect.logEn: You choose to pass on this opportunity.

name: 月下灵湖
text: 夜色清寒，湖面映月，灵气极盛。
textEn: A cold night. Moonlight reflects on the lake, and the spirit energy is intense.

effect.log: 月华入体，伤势平复。
effect.logEn: Moonlight enters your body, healing your wounds.

choices.label: 采湖心莲
choices.descEn: Risky, but may yield a treasure.

effect.log: 你摘得湖心莲。
effect.logEn: You pluck the lotus from the center of the lake.

effect.log: 你安静守夜，平安无事。
effect.logEn: A quiet night passes without incident.

name: 劫修拦路
text: 一名劫修拦在山路中央，狞笑着要你交出丹药。
textEn: A rogue cultivator blocks the mountain path, sneering and demanding your pills.

effect.log: 你决定正面迎敌。
effect.logEn: You decide to face the enemy head-on.

choices.label: 交出灵石
choices.descEn: Pay your way out of trouble.

effect.log: 你交出灵石，暂时脱身。
effect.logEn: You hand over spirit stones and escape for now.

effect.log: 你抢先出手，剑气直逼其心口。
effect.logEn: You strike first — sword qi aimed right at the heart.

name: 废丹炉
text: 一座废弃丹炉在山崖边嗡鸣，似有残丹。
textEn: An abandoned pill furnace hums at the cliff edge. Remnant pills may linger within.

effect.log: 你翻出一枚残丹。
effect.logEn: You find a remnant pill inside.

effect.log: 你勉强炼出聚气丹。
effect.logEn: You barely manage to refine a Qi Gathering Pill.

effect.log: 丹炉炸开一道黑烟。
effect.logEn: The furnace erupts in a plume of black smoke.

name: 残破传承
text: 石壁上残留古老传承，字迹还可辨认。
textEn: Ancient teachings linger on a stone wall, the inscriptions still legible.

effect.log: 你学会了踏云步。
effect.logEn: You master the Cloud Stride technique.

choices.label: 刻印带走
choices.descEn: Take a rubbing for later study.

effect.log: 你刻下拓印，获得灵石奖励。
effect.logEn: You copy the inscription and receive spirit stones as reward.

effect.log: 你毁去痕迹，气机却反噬一瞬。
effect.logEn: You destroy the traces, but the energy backlashes briefly.

name: 流动丹摊
text: 街角出现一个神秘丹摊，价格忽高忽低。
textEn: A mysterious pill stall appears at the street corner with fluctuating prices.

effect.log: 你买下聚气丹。
effect.logEn: You purchase a Qi Gathering Pill.

effect.log: 你买下延寿丹。
effect.logEn: You purchase a Longevity Pill.

effect.log: 你白得一瓶回春丹。
effect.logEn: You walk away with a free Rejuvenation Pill.

name: 乌云压顶
text: 天色骤变，云中已有雷意翻滚。
textEn: The sky darkens suddenly. Thunder intent roils within the clouds.

effect.log: 你直面雷云，试图借劫淬体。
effect.logEn: You face the storm, trying to temper your body with tribulation lightning.

effect.log: 你撑起护阵，稳住心神。
effect.logEn: You raise a protective formation, steadying your mind.

effect.log: 你躲过一劫，却失了机缘。
effect.logEn: You survive the tribulation but miss an opportunity.

name: 灵兽幼崽
text: 一只受伤的灵兽幼崽蜷缩在石缝中。
textEn: A wounded spirit beast cub huddles in a crevice between rocks.

effect.log: 灵兽记住了你的气息。
effect.logEn: The spirit beast remembers your scent.

effect.log: 你成功收服灵兽气息。
effect.logEn: You successfully bind the beast's essence.

effect.log: 你转身离开。
effect.logEn: You turn and walk away.

name: 古门遗址
text: 古门半开，里面的灵压令人心悸。
textEn: The ancient gate stands half-open. The spiritual pressure within is suffocating.

effect.log: 你踏入古门遗址。
effect.logEn: You step through the ancient gate.

effect.log: 你以符探路，摸到秘藏。
effect.logEn: Your talismans reveal a hidden cache.

effect.log: 你封住古门，保住性命。
effect.logEn: You seal the gate and preserve your life.

name: 静室入定
text: 一间无主静室可供修行。
textEn: An ownerless meditation chamber is available for cultivation.

effect.log: 你在静室内稳步吐纳。
effect.logEn: You cultivate steadily in the meditation chamber.

effect.log: 你熬炼筋骨，气血更稳。
effect.logEn: You temper your body. Vitality stabilizes.

effect.log: 暗格里压着半卷残篇。
effect.logEn: A half-scroll lies hidden in the compartment.

name: 灵泉喷涌
text: 地下灵泉破土而出，水汽氤氲。
textEn: An underground spirit spring bursts forth, mist rising into the air.

effect.log: 灵泉洗去疲惫。
effect.logEn: The spirit spring washes away your exhaustion.

choices.label: 收集灵泉
choices.descEn: Take some spirit liquid with you.

effect.log: 你收集了一瓶灵泉。
effect.logEn: You bottle some spirit spring water.

effect.log: 你封住灵泉，获得一丝稳定机缘。
effect.logEn: You seal the spring, gaining a steady stream of fortune.

name: 石亭论道
text: 一位看不清面目的老者邀你论道。
textEn: An enigmatic elder invites you to discuss the Dao.

effect.log: 你在论道中获益匪浅。
effect.logEn: You gain great insight from the discussion.

effect.log: 老者大笑，传你一式剑诀。
effect.logEn: The elder laughs heartily and teaches you a sword technique.

effect.log: 老者点头离去。
effect.logEn: The elder nods and departs.

name: 夜市黑摊
text: 黑市摊位上摆着来路不明的法宝。
textEn: The black market stall displays artifacts of unknown origin.

effect.log: 你买下飞剑。
effect.logEn: You purchase the flying sword.

effect.log: 你买下护符。
effect.logEn: You purchase the amulet.

effect.log: 黑摊收了你的灵石，还丢给你一枚残丹。
effect.logEn: The dealer takes your coins and tosses you a leftover pill.

name: 古碑铭文
text: 一块古碑上刻着模糊的铭文。
textEn: An ancient stele bears faded inscriptions.

effect.log: 你带走了古碑拓本。
effect.logEn: You take a rubbing of the stele.

effect.log: 你悟出部分雷法。
effect.logEn: You grasp fragments of the thunder art.

effect.log: 古碑微光闪烁。
effect.logEn: The stele glimmers faintly.

name: 流星坠地
text: 一颗流星坠入山谷，残留灼热气息。
textEn: A meteor crashes into the valley, leaving scorching traces.

effect.log: 你捡到一件残破法器。
effect.logEn: You find a broken artifact.

effect.log: 你淬炼出一点陨铁精华。
effect.logEn: You refine a bit of meteoric iron essence.

effect.log: 你平稳避开危险。
effect.logEn: You safely avoid the danger.

name: 腐桥断流
text: 一座破桥横跨黑水，脚下极不稳当。
textEn: A crumbling bridge spans dark waters. The footing is treacherous.

effect.log: 你险险跃过断桥。
effect.logEn: You barely leap across the broken bridge.

effect.log: 你修好断桥。
effect.logEn: You repair the bridge.

effect.log: 你找到一艘旧渡船，拿到些许灵石。
effect.logEn: You find an old ferry and pick up a few spirit stones.

name: 游侠剑修
text: 一名孤身剑修与你擦肩，似要传你一招。
textEn: A lone sword cultivator brushes past you, seeming willing to teach a move.

effect.log: 你学得踏云步。
effect.logEn: You learn the Cloud Stride.

effect.log: 你虽受伤，却也磨砺了剑意。
effect.logEn: Wounded but with sharpened sword intent.

effect.log: 剑修收下灵石后赠你一瓶丹药。
effect.logEn: The swordsman accepts your coins and gifts you a pill.

name: 坠星残阵
text: 天外星芒落下，地面浮现残阵。
textEn: Starlight falls from beyond, revealing a residual formation on the ground.

effect.log: 你取走了残阵核心。
effect.logEn: You extract the formation core.

effect.log: 残阵被你看出门道。
effect.logEn: You discern the formation's secrets.

effect.log: 你毁去残阵，却惊出一缕寒气。
effect.logEn: You destroy the formation, but a cold wisp escapes.

name: 药谷采药
text: 一片灵草遍地的山谷静静敞开。
textEn: A valley covered with spirit herbs lies open before you.

effect.log: 你采到几株灵草。
effect.logEn: You harvest several spirit herbs.

effect.log: 你在谷底找到破境丹。
effect.logEn: You find a Breakthrough Pill deep in the valley.

effect.log: 你炼成一瓶聚气丹。
effect.logEn: You refine a Qi Gathering Pill.

name: 晶石洞府
text: 洞中墙壁镶满灵晶，适合闭关。
textEn: The cave walls are studded with spirit crystals — perfect for seclusion.

effect.log: 你在洞中苦修。
effect.logEn: You cultivate intensely in the cave.

effect.log: 你带走几块灵晶。
effect.logEn: You take several spirit crystals.

effect.log: 你留下道号，灵光微闪。
effect.logEn: You leave your Dao name. A faint glow responds.

name: 结缘灵藤
text: 一株灵藤缠住了你的脚踝，似在求助。
textEn: A spirit vine wraps around your ankle, seemingly asking for help.

effect.log: 灵藤回赠一枚护符。
effect.logEn: The vine gifts you an amulet in return.

effect.log: 灵藤断裂，你拾得一点灵液。
effect.logEn: The vine snaps. You collect a drop of spirit liquid.

effect.log: 灵藤沉入土中，留下丹香。
effect.logEn: The vine sinks into the earth, leaving behind the scent of pills.

name: 风崖试炼
text: 高崖风大，适合磨砺心性。
textEn: Strong winds atop the cliff — perfect for tempering one's resolve.

effect.log: 你在狂风中稳住心神。
effect.logEn: You steady your mind against the raging wind.

effect.log: 你借风势练剑。
effect.logEn: You practice swordplay with the wind.

choices.label: 下崖寻洞
choices.labelEn: Climb Down to Find a Cave

effect.log: 你找到一处避风洞，收获一枚丹药。
effect.logEn: You find a sheltered cave and a pill within.

name: 摆渡老翁
text: 一名摆渡老翁要求你帮他渡河。
textEn: An old ferryman asks for your help crossing the river.

effect.log: 老翁送你一只灵葫芦。
effect.logEn: The old man gives you a spirit gourd.

effect.log: 你平安渡河。
effect.logEn: You cross the river safely.

effect.log: 你向老翁告辞。
effect.logEn: You bid the old man farewell.

name: 鬼魅低语
text: 耳边忽然响起低语，似有怨灵窥视。
textEn: A sudden whisper reaches your ears — a wraith seems to be watching.

effect.log: 你镇住怨气。
effect.logEn: You suppress the resentful energy.

effect.log: 怨灵散去，你获得一段寿元。
effect.logEn: The wraith dissipates, granting you extra lifespan.

effect.log: 法宝震散怨气。
effect.logEn: Your artifact shatters the resentful energy.

name: 云游僧人
text: 一位身披破袈裟的僧人拦下你，说能看出你的命数。
textEn: A monk in tattered robes stops you, claiming to see your fate.

effect.log: 僧人轻叹，赠你一枚护身符。
effect.logEn: The monk sighs softly and gives you a protective charm.

effect.log: 僧人合掌，你感到气机清明。
effect.logEn: The monk clasps his hands in prayer. Your mind clears.

effect.log: 你绕开僧人，莫名感到一丝惋惜。
effect.logEn: You walk around the monk, feeling a faint sense of regret.

name: 冻泉破冰
text: 一处山泉被寒气封冻，冰层下隐约有光。
textEn: A mountain spring is frozen over. Something glows faintly beneath the ice.

effect.log: 你破冰取出一枚残损法器。
effect.logEn: You break through the ice and retrieve a damaged artifact.

effect.log: 寒气入体，但泉水清澈，灵力回升。
effect.logEn: Cold invades your body, but the spring water is pure. Qi rises.

effect.log: 你选择离去，寒意随风散。
effect.logEn: You choose to leave. The chill fades with the wind.

name: 千年灵菇
text: 巨石下长着一株通体发光的巨型灵菇，孢子飘散在空气中。
textEn: A massive glowing mushroom grows beneath a boulder, its spores drifting in the air.

effect.log: 孢子入体，神识一阵晕眩，随后感到无比清明。
effect.logEn: Spores enter your body — brief dizziness, then extraordinary clarity.

effect.log: 你小心取下一片，炼成丹药。
effect.logEn: You carefully take a piece and refine it into a pill.

effect.log: 孢子结成粉末，你搜集了数份。
effect.logEn: The spores form a powder. You collect several portions.

name: 铸剑余炉
text: 一座无主铸剑炉还有余温，地上散落着铁屑与符文残片。
textEn: An ownerless sword forge still radiates warmth. Iron shavings and rune fragments litter the ground.

choices.label: 淬炼自身
choices.descEn: Use the forge fire to strengthen yourself.

effect.log: 炉火熔炼，你的气血与攻势都有所增强。
effect.logEn: The forge fire tempers you. Both vitality and offense improve.

effect.log: 你从残片中悟出一丝剑意。
effect.logEn: You glean a trace of sword intent from the fragments.

effect.log: 炉灰中混着几枚灵石。
effect.logEn: A few spirit stones are mixed in the furnace ashes.

name: 乌鸦示警
text: 一只通体乌黑的神鸦落在你肩上，喙中衔着一片残损竹简。
textEn: A jet-black divine crow lands on your shoulder, a tattered bamboo slip in its beak.

effect.log: 竹简上只有八个字：死生有命，莫逆天数。
effect.logEn: Eight words on the scroll: Life and death are fated — defy not the heavens.

effect.log: 乌鸦振翅而去，地上留下几枚灵石。
effect.logEn: The crow takes flight, leaving a few spirit stones on the ground.

effect.log: 竹简自燃，你悟出一丝天道气息。
effect.logEn: The scroll self-immolates. You glimpse a fragment of heavenly law.

name: 无人神祠
text: 荒野中一座小祠无人祭拜，神像面目模糊，香炉里还有半截残香。
textEn: A small shrine stands forgotten in the wilderness. The idol's face is worn; half an incense stick remains.

effect.log: 香烟升起，你莫名感到一段寿元回流。
effect.logEn: Smoke rises. You inexplicably feel your lifespan extending.

effect.log: 供品早已腐烂，只有一枚古铜符。
effect.logEn: The offerings have long rotted. Only an ancient bronze talisman remains.

effect.log: 神祠显出淡淡金光，你体内气机顺畅。
effect.logEn: The shrine emits a faint golden glow. Your qi flows smoothly.

name: 镜面幽潭
text: 潭水平静如镜，倒映出一个与你相似却身着仙衣的影像。
textEn: The pool is still as a mirror, reflecting an image of you in immortal robes.

effect.log: 影像触动了你对上境的感知，修为微动。
effect.logEn: The vision stirs your perception of the next realm.

effect.log: 幻境碎散，潭底涌出一股灵气。
effect.logEn: The illusion shatters. Spirit energy surges from the pool's depths.

effect.log: 你平稳绕行，神识未受干扰。
effect.logEn: You walk around calmly. Your mind remains undisturbed.

name: 剑冢遗址
text: 山坡上插满破剑残刃，这里曾是一场大战的终点。
textEn: Broken swords jut from the hillside — the resting place of a great battle.

effect.log: 千人剑意涌入你体内，气脉震颤。
effect.logEn: A thousand sword intents pour into your body, shaking your meridians.

effect.log: 你熔合碎片，凑成一件残兵器。
effect.logEn: You fuse the fragments into a makeshift weapon.

effect.log: 无数残魂平息，你感到气运有所回转。
effect.logEn: Countless restless spirits find peace. Your fortune shifts.

name: 宗门巡察
text: 一支宗门执法队正在盘查散修，为首者腰别令牌，神色冷漠。
textEn: A sect enforcement squad inspects rogue cultivators. The leader, badge at his waist, looks cold.

effect.log: 你出示修行凭证，执法队放行，还给了些盘缠。
effect.logEn: You show your credentials. The squad lets you pass with some travel funds.

effect.log: 你悄悄递出灵石，顺利通过。
effect.logEn: You quietly slip them spirit stones and pass without trouble.

effect.log: 你硬闯出包围圈，但受了点伤。
effect.logEn: You force your way out of the encirclement, taking some damage.

name: 凡人集市
text: 一座热闹的凡人小镇，摊贩呼喝，炊烟袅袅，到处都是尘世烟火气。
textEn: A lively mortal town. Vendors call out, chimney smoke curls — the warmth of ordinary life.

effect.log: 你在草药摊上凑成一瓶丹药。
effect.logEn: You piece together a pill from the herb stall.

effect.log: 你隐去修士气息，感受凡人烟火，心神安定。
effect.logEn: You suppress your aura and soak in mortal life. Peace settles in.

effect.log: 你以低价收购几株不起眼的灵草，提炼成丹。
effect.logEn: You buy cheap-looking spirit herbs and refine them into pills.

name: 炼丹老翁
text: 山路旁一位白须老者正守着一座小炉，丹香扑鼻。
textEn: A white-bearded elder tends a small furnace by the mountain path. The scent of pills fills the air.

effect.log: 老翁授你一道炼气心法，修为微进。
effect.logEn: The elder teaches you a qi refinement technique. Your cultivation advances.

effect.log: 你以几枚灵石换得两瓶上品丹药。
effect.logEn: You trade spirit stones for two premium pills.

effect.log: 炉火稳住，老翁赠你一枚破境丹。
effect.logEn: The fire steadies. The elder gifts you a Breakthrough Pill.

name: 兽群冲关
text: 一群山兽受了惊吓，从山道冲来，挡路者必遭踩踏。
textEn: A herd of mountain beasts stampedes down the path. Anyone in the way will be trampled.

effect.log: 你腾身而起，兽群从脚下奔涌而过。
effect.logEn: You soar upward as the herd thunders beneath you.

effect.log: 你放出灵压，兽群四散，但消耗不小。
effect.logEn: You release spirit pressure. The herd scatters, but at great cost.

effect.log: 你借势将兽群引走，发现了它们藏匿的旧洞。
effect.logEn: You redirect the herd and discover their hidden old den.

name: 诅咒古井
text: 一口古井散发刺鼻的灵气，井沿刻满了封禁符文，大半已碎裂。
textEn: An ancient well emits pungent spirit energy. Sealing runes on the rim are mostly shattered.

effect.log: 符印碎裂，一道阴气直冲而来，但你抢到了井底沉宝。
effect.logEn: The seals shatter. Dark energy surges up, but you seize the treasure below.

effect.log: 你重新加固了符文，诅咒散去，得到了一段感悟。
effect.logEn: You reinforce the runes. The curse dissipates, granting you insight.

effect.log: 你绕开古井，保住了清明心神。
effect.logEn: You go around the well, keeping your mind clear.

name: 灵兽契约
text: 一只通体青翠的灵鹿盘踞山顶，眼中含着契约的光芒。
textEn: A jade-green spirit deer sits atop the mountain, its eyes glowing with a pact's light.

effect.log: 你与灵鹿订约，其灵力馈入你体。
effect.logEn: You form a pact with the spirit deer. Its power flows into you.

effect.log: 灵鹿不从，化为妖气袭来。
effect.logEn: The deer refuses, transforming into demonic energy and attacking.

effect.log: 灵鹿主动靠近，在你肩头留下一缕灵息。
effect.logEn: The deer approaches, leaving a wisp of spirit energy on your shoulder.

name: 古迹探索
text: 丛林中一座古代仙门遗址若隐若现，里面的阵法犹有余威。
textEn: An ancient immortal sect ruin shimmers through the jungle. Its formations still pulse with power.

effect.log: 你破开残阵，深入内部，惊动了沉睡的守卫。
effect.logEn: You breach the formation and enter, waking a sleeping guardian.

effect.log: 你从阵外感悟残留的阵法构造，神识大进。
effect.logEn: You study the formation from outside. Your divine sense greatly improves.

effect.log: 遗址边缘有前人遗留的储物袋。
effect.logEn: A storage pouch left by a predecessor lies at the ruin's edge.

name: 诅咒法器
text: 路旁一件散发幽光的法器无主悬空，散发着吸引与排斥并存的气息。
textEn: A glowing, ownerless artifact floats by the road, emanating both attraction and repulsion.

effect.log: 诅咒暂被压制，法器归你所有，但气血受损。
effect.logEn: The curse is suppressed. The artifact is yours, but your vitality suffers.

effect.log: 你花了大量灵力解咒，法器随后老实落入手中。
effect.logEn: You spend great MP to break the curse. The artifact obediently falls into your hands.

effect.log: 法器毁去时释放出一道灵力，滋养了你的修为。
effect.logEn: Destroying the artifact releases spirit energy that nourishes your cultivation.

name: 魔修伏击
text: 一名老牌魔修从暗处突然现身，气势汹汹，摆明了要劫走你的功法传承。
textEn: A veteran demon cultivator ambushes you from the shadows, intent on stealing your techniques.

effect.log: 你拔剑迎敌，大战一场。
effect.logEn: You draw your sword and engage in fierce combat.

effect.log: 你以迷雾遮蔽身形，借机遁走。
effect.logEn: You cloak yourself in mist and escape.

choices.label: 以宝换命
choices.descEn: Spend wealth to save your life.

effect.log: 你丢出一件法器转移注意力，乘机逃脱。
effect.logEn: You throw an artifact as a distraction and seize the chance to flee.

name: 雷法残卷
text: 一块岩壁上刻着半残的雷法功诀，已历经数百年风雨。
textEn: A rock face bears a half-ruined thunder technique, weathered by centuries of wind and rain.

effect.log: 你尽力推演，终于领悟了雷法精髓。
effect.logEn: Through intense effort, you finally grasp the essence of the thunder art.

effect.log: 你带走了拓印，感觉日后大有用处。
effect.logEn: You take the rubbing. It will surely prove useful later.

effect.log: 你毁去功诀，却从中感悟到一点天雷之道。
effect.logEn: You destroy the technique but glean a sliver of heavenly thunder wisdom.

name: 空间裂隙
text: 天地间突然撕开一道细微的裂隙，里面流出浓郁的异界灵气。
textEn: A thin rift tears through space, leaking dense otherworldly spirit energy.

effect.log: 你取出一件来自异界的法器，裂隙随即合拢。
effect.logEn: You pull out an otherworldly artifact. The rift seals shut.

effect.log: 异界灵气浓郁，短暂的引气让你修为大进。
effect.logEn: The otherworldly energy is rich. Brief absorption yields great progress.

effect.log: 你封住裂隙，天道隐隐给你一段气运回馈。
effect.logEn: You seal the rift. The Heavenly Dao subtly rewards your fortune.

name: 大修路过
text: 一位境界远超你的大修士一掌拂过，留下浓郁气息，似乎有所指点。
textEn: A cultivator far beyond your realm brushes past, leaving a rich aura — a subtle hint of guidance.

effect.log: 大修驻足片刻，点拨你几句，神识豁然开朗。
effect.logEn: The great cultivator pauses to offer a few words. Your mind clears instantly.

effect.log: 你感悟大修残留气息，悟出一丝更高境界的法则。
effect.logEn: You sense the lingering aura and grasp a sliver of higher-realm law.

effect.log: 大修回头微笑，赠你一枚古币，言：此物自有用处。
effect.logEn: The great cultivator smiles back, gifting you an ancient coin: 'This will serve you well.'

name: 禁忌功法
text: 机缘巧合，你得到了一卷被列为禁忌的功法，天道异象随之而来。
textEn: By chance, you obtain a scroll containing a forbidden art. Heavenly omens follow.

effect.log: 功法凶险，但威力非凡，修为骤增，身体亦受创。
effect.logEn: The art is perilous but immensely powerful. Cultivation surges; body suffers.

effect.log: 你封住功法，天道异象消散，只余一丝机缘在手。
effect.logEn: You seal the art. The heavenly omens fade, leaving only a trace of fortune.

effect.log: 功法焚尽，天道给你一段因果清明的奖励。
effect.logEn: The art burns away. The Heavenly Dao rewards your karmic clarity.

name: 残魂回响
text: 一位飞升未成的强大修士的残魂在此地徘徊，向你传递关于上境的只言片语。
textEn: The remnant soul of a powerful cultivator who failed to ascend lingers here, whispering fragments about the next realm.

effect.log: 残魂将毕生感悟压缩成一道印记传你，气势大增。
effect.logEn: The soul compresses a lifetime of insight into a mark and transfers it to you.

effect.log: 残魂平静散去，留下一道气运为谢。
effect.logEn: The soul departs peacefully, leaving a strand of fortune as thanks.

effect.log: 你主动问询，残魂给出答案后消散，你对天道有了新的感悟。
effect.logEn: You ask directly. The soul answers, then fades. You gain new Dao insight.

name: 天穹裂缝
text: 晴空万里中突然出现一道金色裂缝，天道法则从中倾泻而出。
textEn: A golden crack appears in the clear sky. Heavenly laws pour through.

effect.log: 天道法则直接冲击你的神识，痛苦万分，但修为骤升。
effect.logEn: Heavenly laws slam into your divine sense. Agonizing, but cultivation soars.

effect.log: 你立于裂缝之下，神识受天道法则洗礼，大有裨益。
effect.logEn: Standing beneath the rift, your spirit is baptized by heavenly laws.

choices.label: 布阵接引
choices.descEn: Channel the laws through a formation.

effect.log: 你以阵法接引天道法则，平稳转化为修为与寿元。
effect.logEn: Your formation channels the laws into cultivation and lifespan.

name: 仙人遗迹
text: 远古飞升之处留有不灭印记，传说此地悟道者十中有九可以顺利飞升。
textEn: An ancient ascension site bears an undying mark. Legend says nine in ten who meditate here ascend.

effect.log: 你在遗迹中闭关，感受古仙气息，修为飞速提升。
effect.logEn: You enter seclusion at the ruin, absorbing ancient immortal essence. Cultivation skyrockets.

choices.label: 搜寻遗物
choices.desc: 找找有没有留下的宝物。

effect.log: 遗迹中藏有古仙遗留的法宝与丹药。
effect.logEn: The ruin hides artifacts and pills left by the ancient immortal.

choices.label: 感应上境
choices.descEn: Touch the gate of ascension with divine sense.

effect.log: 你感应到飞升之门，离成仙又近了一步。
effect.logEn: You sense the gate of ascension — one step closer to immortality.

name: 天道试炼
text: 天道降下考验，你面对着一场无法回避的正面试炼。
textEn: The Heavenly Dao sends a trial. You face an unavoidable test.

effect.log: 你正面迎接天罚阴兵的考验。
effect.logEn: You face the Celestial Enforcer's test head-on.

effect.log: 你祭出全力，以重宝抵挡天道考验。
effect.logEn: You unleash everything, using precious treasures to withstand the trial.

effect.log: 你低头受罚，天道给你留下一线生机与警告。
effect.logEn: You bow and accept punishment. The Heavenly Dao leaves you alive with a warning.

name: 飞升前夕
text: 漫漫修行已近尾声，天边隐约出现了仙门的轮廓，你站在最后的抉择前。
textEn: Your long cultivation nears its end. The immortal gate's silhouette appears on the horizon. A final choice awaits.

effect.log: 你将毕生积累倾注一处，天道感应，修为大进。
effect.logEn: You pour a lifetime's cultivation into a single surge. The Dao responds.

effect.log: 你放缓步伐，稳固道基，成功率提高。
effect.logEn: You slow down to fortify your foundation. Success rate improves.

effect.log: 你将一生感悟刻入山壁，天地回应，运气逆转。
effect.logEn: You carve a lifetime of insight into the cliff. Heaven and earth respond; fortune shifts.

name: 暗影魔修
text: 一股阴冷的魂魄波动从地底涌出，一名黑袍魔修缓缓现形，双眼没有瞳孔。
textEn: A chilling soul ripple surges from underground. A black-robed demon cultivator materializes — eyeless.

effect.log: 你感应到对方的魂魄压制，拔剑迎战。
effect.logEn: You sense the enemy's soul pressure and draw your sword.

effect.log: 你以神识对抗阴影，灵魂震颤。
effect.logEn: You pit your divine sense against the shadow. Your soul trembles.

effect.log: 你祭出护符，阴影暂退，你夺路而走。
effect.logEn: You deploy a talisman. The shadow retreats briefly, and you flee.

name: 上古异兽苏醒
text: 大地震颤，远古封印崩裂，一只体型如山的异兽从沉睡中醒来，灵压覆盖数里。
textEn: The earth trembles. An ancient seal shatters. A mountain-sized beast awakens, its aura blanketing miles.

effect.log: 你祭出全力，与远古存在对决。
effect.logEn: You unleash everything and duel the primordial being.

effect.log: 你借异兽灵压锤炼己身，痛苦中有所突破。
effect.logEn: You use the beast's pressure to temper yourself. Pain yields progress.

effect.log: 你全力遁走，异兽并未追击。
effect.logEn: You flee at full speed. The beast does not pursue.

name: 劫雷锤炼
text: 天际劫云翻涌，紫色雷霆隐现。这不是天劫本体，但劫雷余波足以锤炼修士肉身。
textEn: Tribulation clouds churn on the horizon, purple lightning flickering. Not the tribulation itself, but its residual thunder can still temper a cultivator's body.

choices.label: 引雷淬体
choices.descEn: Strengthen the body with tribulation lightning.

effect.log: 劫雷贯体，你咬牙承受，肉身更加坚韧。
effect.logEn: Lightning courses through you. You grit your teeth — your body grows tougher.

choices.label: 以阵接雷
choices.descEn: Use a formation to convert lightning.

effect.log: 你布下引雷阵，将劫雷转化为纯净灵力。
effect.logEn: You deploy a formation to convert tribulation lightning into pure spirit energy.

effect.log: 你远观劫云运行，对天道法则有了更深领悟。
effect.logEn: You watch the tribulation clouds from afar, gaining deeper insight into heavenly laws.

name: 心魔试探
text: 突然间，你看到了过去修行中所有的遗憾——未救之人、错失之缘、背弃之盟。心魔化形，与你对坐。
textEn: Suddenly you see every regret of your cultivation — those you failed to save, opportunities missed, oaths broken. The heart demon manifests, sitting opposite you.

effect.log: 你坦然面对过往，心魔在你的坦诚前消散。道心更加坚固。
effect.logEn: You face the past with honesty. The heart demon dissolves before your sincerity. Your Dao heart strengthens.

choices.label: 以力镇压
choices.descEn: Overpower the demon with raw strength.

effect.log: 你以绝对修为压制心魔，虽然粗暴但有效。
effect.logEn: You crush the heart demon with sheer power. Crude but effective.

effect.log: 你与心魔交谈，发现它是你自己的一部分。两者合一，你的神识空前清明。
effect.logEn: You converse with the demon and realize it is part of you. Merging, your mind reaches unprecedented clarity.

name: 九天引路
text: 一道金色光柱从天而降，照亮了通往九天的道路。这是飞升前的最后指引。
textEn: A golden pillar of light descends from heaven, illuminating the path to the Nine Heavens — the final guide before ascension.

effect.log: 光柱灌注全身，你距离飞升又近了一大步。
effect.logEn: The light floods through you. You are one great step closer to ascension.

effect.log: 你在金光中盘膝，所有属性都得到了提升。
effect.logEn: You meditate in the golden light. All attributes improve.

effect.log: 你将天道轨迹刻入神识，这份感悟将在关键时刻助你一臂之力。
effect.logEn: You engrave the heavenly pattern into your divine sense. This insight will serve you at a critical moment.

name: 三宗来使
text: 一座茶楼里坐着三位修士，分别来自剑宗、丹宗和符宗。他们都对你展现了招揽之意。
textEn: In a teahouse sit three cultivators from the Sword, Alchemy, and Talisman Sects — all extending invitations.

effect.log: 你选择了剑宗，以剑入道。
effect.logEn: You choose the Sword Sect — the path of the blade.

effect.log: 你选择了丹宗，炼丹悟药。
effect.logEn: You choose the Alchemy Sect — the way of the pill.

effect.log: 你选择了符宗，画符布阵。
effect.logEn: You choose the Talisman Sect — the art of formations.

name: 剑道切磋
text: 剑宗同门邀你切磋剑法，剑光交织间暗藏指点。
textEn: A fellow Sword Sect disciple invites you to spar. Hidden teachings lie within the clashing blades.

effect.log: 你在切磋中悟出新的剑招。
effect.logEn: You discover a new sword move through sparring.

effect.log: 前辈指点，你的剑意更加凝练。
effect.logEn: The elder's guidance refines your sword intent.

effect.log: 你在旁观中有所感悟。
effect.logEn: You gain insight from watching.

name: 剑意传承
text: 剑宗秘阁开放一日，你有机会进入参悟上古剑意残卷。
textEn: The Sword Sect's secret vault opens for a day. You may study ancient sword intent scrolls.

effect.log: 你悟出了上古剑意的一缕真谛。
effect.logEn: You grasp a thread of the ancient sword intent's true essence.

effect.log: 你细细品读，剑道根基更加深厚。
effect.logEn: You study carefully. Your sword dao foundation deepens.

effect.log: 你抄下要点，带回细细钻研。
effect.logEn: You copy the key points for later research.

name: 炼丹大会
text: 丹宗举办年度炼丹大会，你被分到一批上品灵草和一座灵炉。
textEn: The Alchemy Sect holds its annual grand assembly. You receive premium spirit herbs and a spirit furnace.

effect.log: 你成功炼出上品丹药！
effect.logEn: You successfully refine premium-grade pills!

effect.log: 你顺利炼成数瓶回春丹。
effect.logEn: You successfully refine several Rejuvenation Pills.

effect.log: 你在药理上有了新的认识。
effect.logEn: You gain new understanding of pharmacology.

name: 药田采集
text: 丹宗药田灵草成熟，你有资格采集一批。
textEn: The Alchemy Sect's herb garden is ripe for harvest. You are allowed to gather a batch.

effect.log: 你采到几株上品灵草。
effect.logEn: You harvest several premium spirit herbs.

effect.log: 你在角落发现了一株极品灵草。
effect.logEn: You discover a supreme-grade spirit herb in a corner.

effect.log: 药田管理者感谢你的帮忙，赠你一枚延寿丹。
effect.logEn: The garden keeper thanks you and gifts a Longevity Pill.

name: 阵法研究
text: 符宗阵法室开放实验，你可以参与一场阵法推演。
textEn: The Talisman Sect's formation lab opens for experiments. You may join a formation drill.

effect.log: 你成功推演出新的阵法变体。
effect.logEn: You successfully derive a new formation variant.

effect.log: 你在协作中积累了阵法经验。
effect.logEn: You gain formation experience through teamwork.

effect.log: 你详细记录了推演数据，日后大有用处。
effect.logEn: You meticulously record the drill data. It will prove useful later.

name: 符箓制作
text: 符宗前辈传授你制作高阶符箓的技巧。
textEn: A Talisman Sect elder teaches you advanced talisman crafting techniques.

effect.log: 你成功制作了一张攻击符箓。
effect.logEn: You successfully craft an attack talisman.

effect.log: 你制成防御符，加固己身。
effect.logEn: You craft a defense talisman, fortifying yourself.

effect.log: 运势符成型，你感到气运微妙变化。
effect.logEn: The fortune talisman takes shape. You sense a subtle shift in luck.
